tasks.label: Git commit and push
tasks.command:
git add -A && git commit -m "fix: COMPILER_BARRIER macro + recalibrate native RAM reference values

- Add #define COMPILER_BARRIER() __asm__ volatile("" ::: "memory") after now_ns()
- now_ns() already has __attribute__((noinline)) to defeat -O3 clock hoisting
- Add COMPILER_BARRIER() before/after memcpy and NEON loops in all 5 tests
- Recalibrate RAM_REFERENCE_NATIVE from actual SD 8 Gen 3 measurements:
  SeqRead 27000 (was 20000), SeqWrite 15000 (was 16000),
  RandAccess 120 ns (was 200), MemCopy 22000 estimate, MultiThread 52000 (was 40000)" && git push
